title: Embed migration guides and SDK snippets into tiered release summaries
creator: Sofia Ramirez
description:
Goal: Produce tiered release notes that include actionable migration guides and validated SDK snippets for each affected language and integration surface. This ticket coordinates writing, validation, and stakeholder sign-off so that customer-facing changelogs and internal briefings contain runnable examples, migration checklists, and rollback guidance.

Scope:
- Create short 'What changed' + 'Why it matters' microcopy per audience (developer, product admin, security/compliance).
- Author per-language SDK snippets for the top 4 supported SDKs (python, node, go, java) demonstrating feature migration or new API usage.
- Add a concise migration checklist (breaking changes, config flags, recommended mitigation) and an automated verification matrix.
- Wire snippet validation into CI: compile/run basic smoke tests and embed verification badges in the release doc.
- Coordinate sign-off with SDK owners, Engineering on-call, Support playbook owner, Legal for wording, and Docs for indexing.

Out-of-scope: full end-to-end SDK releases (handled by ENG-31245) and detailed billing calculations (handled in separate PM ticket).
acceptance_criteria: Customer-facing release note draft with short developer, admin, and compliance sections
Per-language code snippets exist for python/node/go/java and pass snippet CI smoke tests
Migration checklist with minimum three remediation steps for each breaking change
Sign-off recorded from SDK owners, Support, and Legal in this ticket's comment thread
Automated snippet verification status badge added to the release doc
